blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.
blocks.zh: 多种模式的大型语言模型综合了各种模式的信息,但当这些模式出现分歧时,则变得不可靠。 在相互冲突的投入下,MLLMs可能倾向于对任务不最可靠的模式,从而促使对模式仲裁进行推断时间控制。 我们确定一些小的注意头,称为仲裁头,这些注意头对预测是遵循视觉证据还是文字证据产生因果关系。 在此基础上,我们采用了一种轻而易举、无训练的干预方法,在推论时将这些头像偏向于一种指定的可信模式。 已查明的头部在各种校准设定的大小上是稳定的,在各种设置上是通用的,指导这些头部能够有效双向控制不同基准对模式的依赖。 我们的研究结果确定了一个有效的控制机制,以便根据具体任务模式的优先事项,对MLLM作出预测。 该编码可在https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modelity-arbitation上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in integrating visual and textual information for tasks ranging from visual question answering to complex multimodal reasoning [ 31 , 33 , 19 , 3 , 36 ] . A central premise behind these models is that information from different modalities can be effectively integrated to support more informed predictions. Yet, most multimodal evaluation implicitly assumes that the available modalities are mutually consistent or complementary [ 17 , 24 , 8 ] . In practice, this assumption does not always hold. The textual and visual inputs may provide contradictory evidence due to noisy annotations, outdated or erroneous descriptions, imperfect retrieval, or inconsistencies among heterogeneous information sources. Recent work has therefore begun to investigate modality conflict , where different modalities support incompatible answers to the same question [ 39 , 37 , 38 ] . Such conflicts expose a fundamental aspect of multimodal reasoning that remains largely hidden when modalities agree: which modality ultimately governs the model’s prediction?
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)在将视觉和文字信息综合起来以完成从视觉问题回答到复杂的多式联运推理[31、33、19、3、36]等任务方面表现出了卓越的能力。 这些模型背后的一个中心前提是,不同模式的信息可以被有效整合,以支持更知情的预测. 然而,大多数多式联运评价隐含地假定,现有模式是相互一致或互补的[17、24、8]。 在实践中,这种假设并非始终有效。 文字和视觉投入可能由于叙述吵闹、描述过时或错误、检索不完善或各种信息来源不一致而提供自相矛盾的证据。 因此,最近的工作已经开始调查模式冲突,其中不同的模式支持对同一问题的不一致的答复[39、37、38]。 这种冲突暴露出多式联运推理的一个根本方面,当模式达成一致时,这一方面基本上仍然隐藏着:模式的预测最终取决于哪种模式?

blocks.en: Existing studies [ 39 , 37 , 38 , 25 , 4 , 27 ] reveal that MLLMs do not treat the modalities neutrally under conflicts. Instead, they exhibit systematic modality preferences, tending to favor one source of evidence over another when the two disagree. Controlled conflict settings [ 38 ] have shown that this behavior is widespread across MLLMs and can vary substantially across models and tasks. As a result, modality preference can directly undermine model reliability. Misleading visual evidence can override an answer that a model correctly derives from text alone [ 10 ] , while erroneous textual information can similarly dominate contradictory visual evidence [ 35 ] . Recent studies consequently identify modality conflict as an important source of multimodal hallucination and robustness failures [ 39 , 32 , 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的研究[39、37、38、25、4、27]显示,在冲突情况下, MLLMs 并不中立地对待模式。 相反,它们表现出系统性的方式偏好,往往倾向于一种证据来源,而不是两种意见不一致时另一种证据来源。 受控制的冲突环境[38]表明,这种行为在MLLMs中广泛存在,并且可能因模型和任务而大相径庭. 因此,模式偏好会直接损害模型的可靠性. 误导视觉证据可以推翻一个答案,即模型正确来源于文本本身[10],而错误的文本信息同样可以支配自相矛盾的视觉证据[35]. 因此,最近的研究将模式冲突确定为造成多式联运幻觉和强力故障的重要根源[39、32、28]。

blocks.en: More importantly, modality conflict is not merely an artificial stress test but a realistic failure mode in practical multimodal applications, where the authoritative modality is often specified by the task but not effectively utilized by the models. For example, medical imaging may serve as the primary evidence for diagnosis while patient metadata provides auxiliary context that should not override visual findings [ 12 , 7 ] . Similarly, in autonomous driving, real-time visual observations should take precedence over risky navigation instructions when safety is at stake [ 26 ] . In these cases, the desired behavior is clear: predictions should follow the designated trusted modality when conflicts happen. However, an MLLM’s intrinsic modality preference may not align with this externally specified priority, potentially leading to consequential errors.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,模式冲突不仅仅是一种人为的压力测试,而是实际多式联运应用中的一种现实的失败模式,在这种模式中,权威模式往往被任务所指定,但被模式所有效利用。 例如,医疗成像可作为诊断的主要证据,而病人元数据则提供辅助上下文,不应凌驾于视觉结果[12,7]. 同样,在自主驾驶时,当安全受到威胁时,实时视觉观测应优先于危险的导航指示[26]。 在这些情况下,所期望的行为是明确的:当冲突发生时,预测应当遵循指定的可信任模式. 然而,MLLM固有的方式偏好可能与外部规定的优先权不相符合,从而可能造成相应的错误。

blocks.en: When the trusted modality is explicitly specified by the task or application, a seemingly straightforward solution is to instruct the model to prioritize the trusted one or simply remove the non-trusted modality. However, neither provides a satisfactory mechanism for controlling multimodal arbitration. Prompt-based instructions preserve both modalities but offer limited controllability. Removing a modality changes the multimodal input itself and bypasses rather than resolves cross-modal conflicts. It also discards potentially useful information in the more common case where the modalities are aligned and sacrifices flexibility when the designated trusted modality varies across tasks or contexts.
blocks.zh: 当任务或应用程序明确指定了被信任模式时,一个看似直截了当的解决方案是指示该模式优先排序被信任模式,或者简单地去除非被信任模式. 然而,两者都未能提供控制多式联运仲裁的令人满意的机制。 即时指示保留两种方式,但提供有限的可控性。 删除一种模式会改变多式联运输入本身,绕过而不是解决跨模式冲突。 在比较常见的情况中,当指定可信任的方式因任务或情况而异时,它也会丢弃可能有用的信息,牺牲灵活性。

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate whether modality arbitration under modality conflict can be effectively controlled through inference-time intervention. We first identify a small set of attention heads, which we term arbitration heads , whose attention patterns are strongly associated with whether model predictions follow visual or textual evidence. We then selectively intervene on these heads at inference time, modulating their attention toward the designated trusted modality. This yields a lightweight, training-free mechanism for bidirectional modality control and we can steer predictions toward either visual or textual evidence according to the specified modality. Importantly, arbitration heads can be identified from only a small calibration set of 10 samples and transfer effectively across benchmarks, suggesting that they capture a reusable mechanism for modality arbitration rather than benchmark-specific correlations.
To conclude, our contributions can be summarized as: • We identify a compact set of arbitration heads associated with whether MLLMs follow visual or textual evidence under modality conflict. • We propose a lightweight, training-free intervention on these heads that enables bidirectional control toward a designated trusted modality while preserving both modalities as input. • We show that arbitration heads identified from a small calibration set generalize across benchmarks, suggesting a generalized mechanism for modality arbitration.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们调查是否能够通过推断时间干预来有效控制模式冲突下的仲裁。 我们首先找出了一小组注意头,我们称之为仲裁头,他们的注意模式与模型预测是遵循视觉证据还是文字证据密切相关。 然后我们在推断时有选择地干预这些头部,调整他们对指定信任方式的注意力。 这就产生了一种轻而易举的、无训练的双向模式控制机制,我们可以根据特定模式引导预测向视觉或文字证据的方向发展。 重要的是,只能从一套小型的10个样本中确定仲裁负责人,并有效跨越基准进行转让,这表明他们掌握了模式仲裁的可重复使用机制,而不是特定基准的关联。
最后,我们的贡献可以归纳为: 我们确定了一套紧凑的仲裁头目,涉及MLLMs是否遵循模式冲突下的视觉证据或文字证据。 我们提议对这些头进行轻量级、无培训的干预,以便双向控制一种指定的可信任模式,同时保留两种模式作为投入。 我们表明,从小规模校正中确定的仲裁负责人确立了跨基准的通用性,建议建立一个通用模式仲裁机制。

blocks.en: We identify a compact set of arbitration heads associated with whether MLLMs follow visual or textual evidence under modality conflict.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了一套紧凑的仲裁头目,涉及MLLMs在模式冲突下是遵循视觉证据还是文字证据。

blocks.en: We propose a lightweight, training-free intervention on these heads that enables bidirectional control toward a designated trusted modality while preserving both modalities as input.
blocks.zh: 我们提议对这些头进行轻而易举、无培训的干预,以便能够对指定的可信方式进行双向控制,同时保留两种方式作为投入。

blocks.en: We show that arbitration heads identified from a small calibration set generalize across benchmarks, suggesting a generalized mechanism for modality arbitration.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,从小规模校正中确定的仲裁负责人确立了跨基准的通用性,建议建立一个通用模式仲裁机制。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Modality Conflict in MLLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 MLLMs中的冲突

blocks.en:
Prior work has shown that multimodal models can exhibit imbalanced reliance across modalities. Such preferences may arise from unimodal shortcuts in the training data, enabling models to solve multimodal tasks by disproportionately relying on a single modality [ 9 , 5 , 14 ] . More recent studies have shifted attention to more concrete settings of modality conflicts in MLLMs to study the model behaviors.
Zhang et al . [ 39 ] formalized conflicts in multimodal inputs and showed that such conflicts in questions and images can induce hallucinations. Cai et al . [ 4 ] demonstrated that irrelevant or misleading information from one modality can degrade reasoning that should rely on another, while CLASH [ 27 ] evaluates whether MLLMs can explicitly detect contradictions between visual and textual evidence. Beyond characterizing failures under conflicts, recent work also examines how models resolve conflicting evidence. Zhang et al . [ 37 ] systematically evaluate modality preference with controlled conflicts and show that preference directions are encoded in hidden states and can be steered. Another work [ 38 ] further decomposes the model behavior under modality conflicts into inherent modality preference and instance-specific relative reasoning uncertainty. Nguyen et al . [ 25 ] investigate the internal conflict-resolution process and find that conflict detection and resolution exhibit distinct representational and attention patterns across layers. Together, these studies reveal that MLLMs exhibit systematic yet steerable behaviors under conflict.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作表明,多式联运模式可能显示不同模式的依赖性不平衡。 这种偏好可能来自培训数据中的单式快捷方式,使模型能够通过过度依赖单一模式[9、5、14]解决多式任务。 更近期的研究将注意力转移到MLLMs更具体的模式冲突环境来研究模式行为.
张等. [39] 将冲突形式化为多模式投入,并表明在问题和图像中的这种冲突可能诱发幻觉. Cai等 [4] 证明,一种方式提供的不相关或误导性信息会降低应当依赖另一种方式的推理,而CLASH [27] 则评价MLLMs能否明确发现视觉证据和文字证据之间的矛盾. 除了描述冲突下的失败之外,最近的工作还审查了模型如何解决相互冲突的证据。 张等. [37] 系统评价模式偏好与可控冲突,并显示偏好方向被编码为隐藏状态并可以被引导. 另一作 [38] 将模式冲突下的模型行为进一步分解为固有的模式偏好和特定实例的相对推理不确定性. Nguyen等人[25]调查内部冲突解决过程,发现发现冲突发现和解决呈现出不同层次的代表和关注模式。 这些研究表明,在冲突期间,MLLMs表现出系统而可引导的行为。

blocks.en: The most relevant work is [ 37 ] , which introduces MPS, a method that identifies a modality-preference direction in the model’s representation space using contrasting conflict examples and steers generation by adding the resulting vector to the model’s hidden states. In contrast, we identify and intervene on attention heads that causally influence conflict arbitration, enabling targeted modality control while providing mechanistic evidence for modality preference. Our intervention also yields stable generation without the additional tuning required by MPS.
blocks.zh: 最相干的工作是[37],它引入了MPS,这个方法通过对比冲突实例确定模型的表示空间中的一种模式偏好方向,并通过将由此产生的向量添加到模型的隐藏状态来引导生成. 相比之下,我们发现并干预了对冲突仲裁具有因果关系的注意力头,从而能够进行有针对性的模式控制,同时为模式偏好提供机械证据。 我们的干预也产生稳定的生成,而不需要MPS要求的额外调试.

blocks.en: 2.2 Inference-time Interventions
blocks.zh: 2.2 推断时间干预

blocks.en:
Inference-time interventions aim to improve model performance without retraining. A major line of work in MLLMs modifies decoding to improve visual grounding, including layer-contrastive decoding [ 6 ] , visual contrastive decoding [ 15 ] , over-trust penalty and retrospection-allocation [ 11 ] , etc. Other methods intervene on attention or representations, such as amplifying image-token attention [ 23 ] , reallocating attention from output tokens to visual tokens [ 29 ] , post-hoc hallucination correction [ 34 ] , and steering modality preference in latent space [ 37 ] .
A line of work in text-only LLMs also intervenes on a sparse set of attention heads,
such as shifting activations along probed directions [ 20 ] , pruning memory-preferring heads [ 13 ] , reweighting attention to specified spans [ 40 ] , or steering heads with superposed signals [ 18 ] .
These methods collectively demonstrate that model behavior can be improved at inference time by modifying decoding, attention, or representations.
blocks.zh:
推论时间干预的目的是在不进行再培训的情况下改进模式业绩。 MLLMs中一条主要的工作线修改了解码来改进视觉地基,包括层相通解码 [6],视觉相通解码 [15],过度信任处罚和回想-分配 [11]等. 其他方法干预了注意力或表达方式,如将图像所关注的放大[23],将注意力从输出符重新分配给视觉符 [29],后发幻觉校正 [34],以及引导模式在潜在空间中的偏好 [37].
仅限文本的LLMS的一行工作,也介入了少数关注头,
例如沿被探测方向转移活化 推倒内存偏重头部 [13], 重估对指定跨度的注意力 [40], 或 以叠接信号向头部 [18].
这些方法集体表明模型行为可以在推论时间通过修改解码,注意,或表示来改进.

blocks.en: We examine how MLLMs behave when information across modalities is aligned or conflicting. As shown in Table 1 , all four models perform well when given either modality independently or when the inputs provide aligned information. However, introducing conflicting text causes a substantial shift in model predictions. Similar behavior occurs across all evaluated models, suggesting that modality conflict induces a non-trivial competition between modalities.

blocks.en: We further validate that this modality preference depends on their relative reliability [ 38 ] . Table 2 progressively degrades the image through Gaussian blurring. While image-only accuracy decreases gradually, the presence of conflicting text causes a much sharper transition in the preferred modality from image to text. These observations suggest that modality preference is neither fixed nor solely determined by the presence of conflicting information, but dynamically changes with the strength of evidence provided by each modality. blocks.en: 3.5 Extension: Adaptive Steering

blocks.en: To avoid unnecessary intervention when modalities are already consistent, we introduce adaptive steering, which dynamically adjusts the intervention strength according to the detected degree of modality conflict. We augment an existing modality-conflict benchmark, MC 2 , whose original data consists of images and corresponding conflicting text. We generate aligned text by rewriting the conflicting text with image-supported answers, so that each image yields both an aligned and a conflicting multimodal input.
blocks.zh: 为了避免在模式已经一致的情况下进行不必要的干预,我们引入了适应性指导,根据检测到的模式冲突程度动态地调整干预强度. 我们加强了现有的模式-冲突基准,即MC 2, 其原始数据由图像和相冲突文本组成。 我们通过用图像支持的答案重写相冲突的文本来生成对齐文本,这样每个图像都会产生对齐和相冲突的多模式输入.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on four modality-conflict benchmarks, including MMCD [ 25 ] , MC 2 [ 37 ] , CLASH [ 27 ] , and CorrelationQA [ 10 ] , and one visual hallucination benchmark PhD [ 22 ] . These benchmarks cover diverse scenarios in which different modalities may lead to competing predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们根据四个模式冲突基准评估我们的方法,包括MMCD [25],MC 2 [37],CLASH [27],以及相关QA [10],以及一个视觉幻觉基准博士[22]。 这些基准涵盖不同的假设情况,其中不同的模式可能导致相互竞争的预测。

blocks.en: MMCD, MC 2 , and CLASH provide annotations for the answers supported by each modality independently, enabling us to explicitly evaluate the model’s preference between conflicting modalities. We consider two evaluation settings: Image-Primary and Text-Primary . For methods that support bidirectional modality steering, we steer generation toward the designated primary modality in each setting. We then report accuracy compared against image-/text-supported answers under each setting. Consequently, successful image-primary steering should increase image accuracy while reducing text accuracy, whereas successful text-primary steering should exhibit the opposite behavior. This bidirectional evaluation directly measures whether a method can controllably shift model predictions toward a designated modality rather than merely improving overall task accuracy. CorrelationQA provides ground-truth answers based on textual information only. We therefore supplement it with corresponding image-supported answers to enable the same bidirectional evaluation. Details of this annotation procedure are provided in Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh: MMCD、MC 2 和 CLASH 提供了由每个模式独立支持的答案的说明,使我们能够明确评价模式在冲突模式之间的偏好。 我们考虑两个评价设置:图像小学和文本小学。 对于支持双向模式引导的方法,我们引导一代在每种情况下向指定的主要模式走去。 然后,我们对照每个设定下图像/文本支持的答案报告准确性。 因此,成功的图像主引导应提高图像准确性并同时降低文本准确性,而成功的文本主引导应显示相反的行为。 这种双向评价直接衡量一种方法是否能够可控地将模型预测转向指定方式,而不仅仅是提高总体任务准确性。 相关QA只根据文字信息提供地基真实答案. 因此,我们用相应的图像支持的答案来补充它,以便进行同样的双向评价。 附录B.4详细介绍了这一说明程序。

blocks.en: We further evaluate on two subsets of PhD [ 22 ] , a benchmark designed to assess visual hallucination in the presence of textual context. Following prior work [ 37 ] , we sample 1000 samples from the subsets PhD-sec and PhD-icc, which contain irrelevant or conflicting textual information, respectively. PhD complements the modality-conflict benchmarks by evaluating whether modality steering can strengthen visual grounding to mitigate hallucinations in the presence of misleading textual context. For PhD, we evaluate both settings using image accuracy, measuring how effectively each method preserves or suppresses reliance on visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价博士的两个子集[22],这是在文字背景下评估视觉幻觉的基准。 继先前的工作[37]之后,我们从各分集的博士分集和博士分集中抽取了1000个样本,这些样本分别载有不相关或相冲突的文字信息。 博士通过评价模式指导是否能够加强视觉基础,在出现误导性文字背景的情况下减少幻觉,从而补充模式-冲突基准。 对博士来说,我们使用图像精度来评价两种设置,衡量每种方法如何有效地保存或抑制对视觉证据的依赖。

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on four open-source MLLMs to examine whether our modality steering generalizes across different multimodal architectures. Specifically, we use Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 2 ] , Qwen3-VL-8B [ 1 ] , LLaVA-OneVision-7B [ 16 ] and InternVL3-8B [ 41 ] .
We compare our method against standard inference strategies and various approaches. In the subsequent sections, Base denotes standard model inference without additional intervention, while CoT [ 30 ] employs chain-of-thought prompting to encourage explicit reasoning before prediction. We additionally include VCD (Visual Contrastive Decoding) [ 15 ] , a decoding-based method for increasing vision grounding and mitigating hallucination. These methods do not explicitly support controlling the direction of modality preference and therefore produce a single set of predictions regardless of whether the desired target is the image or text modality.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了四个开源的MLLMs的实验,以检查我们的模式是否贯穿于不同的多模式架构。 具体来说,我们使用的是Quen2.5-VL-7B [2],Quen3-VL-8B [1],LLaVA-One Vision-7B [16]和InternVL3-8B [41].
我们把我们的方法与标准推论策略和各种方法进行比较。 在接下来的章节中,Base表示标准模型推论,没有额外的干预,而CoT[30]则采用思维链来激励在预测前明确推理. 此外,我们还包括VCD(视觉相矛盾解码)[15],这是一种以解码为基础的方法,用于增加视觉地平线并减轻幻觉. 这些方法并不明确支持控制模式偏好的方向,因此无论希望的目标是图像还是文本模式,都会产生一套单一的预测.

blocks.en:
We further compare against two baselines capable of bidirectional modality steering. CAP (Conflict-Aware Prompting) explicitly instructs the model to answer according to either the image or the textual context, providing a prompting-based baseline for modality control. MPS (Modality Preference Steering), introduced in MC 2 [ 37 ] , provides a baseline for steering predictions toward a specified modality by computing a steering vector from a set of samples. For each MLLM, our method uses 10 samples from MC 2 to localize top-30 arbitration heads among over 1000 heads, and uses α = 30 \alpha=30 as intervention strength for the main experiments where conflicts are explicitly presented. We additionally use the augmented MC 2 to demonstrate the adaptive steering.
For CAP, MPS, and our method, we evaluate the image- and text-directed variants under the image-primary and text-primary settings, respectively. More experiment details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
我们进一步比较两个能够双向模式引导的基线。 CAP(冲突提示)明确指示模型根据图像或文字上下文进行回答,为模式控制提供了以提示为基础的基线. MC 2 [37] 中引入的MPS(模式偏好引导),通过从一组样本中计算出一个向导矢量,为引导预测某一特定模式提供了一个基线。 对于每个MLLM,我们的方法使用MC 2的10个样本,在1000多头中使上-30个仲裁头的地方化,并使用α = 30\ α = 30作为明确呈现冲突的主要实验的干预力量. 我们还利用增强的MC 2来展示适应性引导.
对于CAP、MPS和我们的方法,我们分别在图像主设置和文本主设置下评价图像和文本主设置。 附录B提供了更多的试验细节。

blocks.en: Table 3 presents the results on four modality-conflict benchmarks across four MLLMs. Overall, our method provides strong and generally consistent bidirectional control of modality preference. Under image-primary steering, it substantially increases image accuracy while suppressing text accuracy. In contrast, under text-primary steering, the preference is effectively reversed. This behavior generalizes across different models and benchmarks, demonstrating that our method can reliably steer predictions toward the designated modality.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了四个小额供资和微型企业的四项模式冲突基准的结果。 总的来说,我们的方法对模式偏好提供了有力和普遍一致的双向控制。 在图像主向导下,它会大幅度地提高图像精度,同时抑制文本精度. 相比之下,在文本主方向下,这种偏好实际上被扭转了。 这种行为概括了不同的模型和基准,表明我们的方法可以可靠地引导预测向指定模式的方向发展.

blocks.en:
Compared with single-direction methods, including Base, CoT, and VCD, our method enables explicit control with superior accuracy toward the naturally preferred modality. Compared with CAP and MPS, our method generally achieves stronger target-modality preference.
Notably, the arbitration heads used for intervention are identified using only 10 calibration samples from MC 2 . Despite this limited calibration, the same identified heads generalize effectively to MMCD, CLASH, and CorrelationQA without benchmark-specific identification. The consistently strong results across benchmarks indicate that the identified heads provide transferable intervention targets rather than dataset-specific control points.
blocks.zh:
与单向方法(包括Base、CoT和VCD)相比,我们的方法能够对自然偏好的模式进行精确明确的控制。 与CAP和MPS相比,我们的方法普遍实现了更强烈的目标模式偏好.
值得注意的是,用于干预的仲裁负责人仅使用MC 2的10个校正样本。 尽管有这种有限的校正,但同样的被识别的头像有效地归纳到MMCD、CLASH和CorrelationQA,没有具体的基准识别。 各项基准之间持续取得的强劲结果表明,已确定的主管提供了可转移的干预目标,而不是特定数据集的控制点。

blocks.en: We further evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B on the PhD visual hallucination benchmark, with results shown in Table 4 . Under image-primary steering, our method achieves the highest image accuracy on PhD-icc and the best performance among bidirectional methods on PhD-sec, remaining competitive with the best single-direction methods. Conversely, text-primary steering reduces image accuracy on both subsets, demonstrating effective suppression of visual preference. These results show that our bidirectional modality control applies to visual hallucination settings and effectively steers the answers.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步根据博士视觉幻觉基准评估Qune3-VL-8B,结果见表4。 在图像主引导下,我们的方法在博士-icc上实现了最高的图像精度,在博士-sec上实现了双向方法的最佳性能,与最佳的单向方法保持了竞争力. 反之,文本主向导降低了两个子集的图像精度,显示出视觉偏好的有效抑制. 这些结果显示,我们的双向模式控制适用于视觉幻觉设置并有效引导答案.

blocks.en: 4.4 Adaptive Steering under Sparse Conflict
blocks.zh: 4.4 小规模冲突下的适应性指导

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Preserving multimodal benefits under sparse modality conflict.
The left and right panels evaluate MPS and our method steered towards image and text, respectively.
Dotted lines denote unimodal performance. Although unimodal inference avoids modality conflict, it cannot exploit complementary information when the modalities are aligned. Adaptive steering retains this benefit while remaining robust to conflict.
blocks.zh:
图4:在稀有模式冲突下保留多式联运利益。
左右面板分别对MPS和我们的方法进行图像和文字评价。
点行表示单式性能。 虽然单模式推论避免了模式冲突,但当模式一致时却不能利用补充信息。 适应性指导保留了这一好处,同时对冲突保持强劲。

blocks.en: We evaluate whether adaptive steering can preserve the benefits of multimodal inference while resolving conflicts when necessary. We vary the proportion of conflicting and aligned samples with our augmented MC 2 and Qwen3-VL-8B to examine how different methods behave as modality agreement changes, especially when the conflicted samples are sparse. When modalities are aligned, information from both modalities can be complementary, allowing multimodal inference to outperform relying on one modality alone.
blocks.zh: 我们评价适应性指导能否在必要情况下解决冲突的同时保留多式联运推论的好处。 我们将相互矛盾和配合的样本比例与我们增强的MC 2和Qune3-VL-8B相去甚远,以审查不同方法在模式协议变化时的表现,特别是在冲突样本稀少的情况下。 在统一模式时,两种模式提供的信息可以互为补充,使多式联运推论仅依靠一种模式就能超越绩效。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 4 , when conflicts are sparse, Base and adaptive steering outperform the unimodal baseline, confirming that
complementary cross-modal evidence is worth exploiting. As the fraction of conflicting samples increases, Base shows a significant performance drop due to the inability to resolve competing evidence. Adaptive steering retains most of the Base advantage on aligned samples while strengthening the designated modality once conflict is detected. The comparison isolates what adaptive steering provides over discarding a modality, that conflict robustness that does not require giving up the complementary information available when the modalities agree.
blocks.zh:
如图4所示,当冲突稀少时,基础和适应性引导比单一模式基线好,从而证实
补充性跨模式证据值得利用。 随着相冲突样本的分数增加,Base显示由于无法解决相冲突证据,性能大幅下降. 在发现冲突后加强指定模式的同时,可调适的引导保留了基地在对齐样品上的大部分优势。 比较将适应性指导为放弃一种模式提供了什么,即冲突强度强而不需要在模式商定时放弃现有补充信息。

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to examine the effects of steering strength, the number of selected arbitration heads, head selection, and modality suppression. As shown in Figure 5 , increasing the steering strength α \alpha progressively shifts predictions toward the designated modality, with performance saturating at moderate values. We therefore use α = 30 \alpha=30 by default. Similarly, Figure 6 shows that increasing the number of top-ranked arbitration heads in a moderate range consistently strengthens modality control, with performance becoming stable around k = 20 k=20 – 30 30 . We select k = 30 k=30 for all main experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们进行减税研究,以审查方向力的影响、选定的仲裁主管人数、头部选择和方式压制。 如图5所显示的,增加转向力α-α逐渐将预测转向指定方式,性能以中度值饱和. 因此,我们默认使用α=30\alpha=30。 同样, 图6显示,在中等范围内增加排名最高的仲裁主管人数,始终加强模式控制,表现稳定在克=20克=20至30克左右。 我们选择k=30k=30 用于所有主要实验.

blocks.en:
Table 5 further demonstrates that which heads are selected is critical. We cover a few head selection criteria: Random chooses 30 heads from all heads, while layer-matched chooses each head from the same layers as the heads selected by ours. Reversed selects 30 heads by filtering the lowest influence scores and All Heads applies the intervention on all heads.
Random, layer-matched random, and reverse-ranked selection all yield substantially weaker control than our identified arbitration heads. Notably, intervening on all heads (over 1000) does not further improve performance, despite using many more heads, confirming that effective steering relies on selectively targeting arbitration heads rather than broadly modifying attention. Finally, removing suppression causes a small performance drop, indicating that augmenting the trusted modality accounts for most of the steering effect, while suppressing the competing modality provides a modest additional improvement.
blocks.zh:
表5还表明,挑选哪些负责人至关重要。 我们涵盖几个头部选择标准:随机从所有头部中选择30个头,而层相匹配的层相匹配的层相匹配的层相匹配的层相匹配的层相匹配的每个头. 倒置通过过滤最小影响分数来选择30个头,而"所有头"将干预应用到所有头上.
随机的,分层的随机的, 和逆向排序的选取 都比我们确定的仲裁主管要弱得多。 值得注意的是,干预所有负责人(超过1 000人)并没有进一步改善业绩,尽管使用了更多的负责人,这证明有效的指导取决于有选择地针对仲裁负责人,而不是广泛地改变注意力。 最后,去除抑制导致性能小幅下降,表明可信赖模式的增强占了引导效应的大部分,而抑制相竞争模式则提供了适度的额外改进.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We study how multimodal arbitration in MLLMs can be controlled under modality conflicts and introduce a training-free approach for controlling which modality governs model predictions. By identifying a small set of arbitration heads associated with modality arbitration and intervening on their attention, our method can steer answer generation toward a trusted modality. Extensive experiments across multiple MLLMs and modality-conflict benchmarks demonstrate consistent and effective bidirectional modality control. The arbitration heads identified from only a small calibration set generalize effectively across benchmarks. Overall, our findings suggest that modality arbitration can be effectively controlled through targeted intervention on a compact set of identified attention heads.
blocks.zh: 我们研究如何在模式冲突下控制MLLMs的多式仲裁,并采用无培训方法控制哪种模式管辖模型预测。 通过确定与模式仲裁有关的一小组仲裁负责人并干预他们的注意力,我们的方法可以引导一代人向一种值得信赖的模式作出回答。 跨越多个 MLLMs 和模式-冲突基准的广泛实验表明,双向模式控制是连贯而有效的。 仅从少量校正中确定的仲裁负责人有效地概括了各种基准。 总而言之,我们的调查结果表明,可以通过对一组已查明的注意事项的契约性负责人进行有针对性的干预,有效地控制模式仲裁。

blocks.en: Our evaluation uses a simplified modality-conflict setup in which the modality to prioritize is externally specified, making routing to unimodal inference a potentially strong baseline. In realistic settings, however, conflicts may be partial, with the correct answer requiring the integration of distinct evidence from multiple modalities. We therefore focus on controlling modality arbitration while retaining both input sources. Benchmarking when both modalities provide useful yet partially conflicting evidence, for which unimodal routing is insufficient, remains an important direction for future work. More discussion is detailed in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们的评价采用了一种简化模式-冲突设置,在这种设置中,确定优先次序的方式由外部规定,使单模式推断的路径成为潜在的强有力的基线。 然而,在现实环境中,冲突可能是片面的,正确的答案需要从多种模式中整合不同的证据。 因此,我们侧重于控制方式仲裁,同时保留两种投入来源。 如果两种模式提供有用但部分相冲突的证据,而单式路由不足,则制定基准仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 进一步的讨论详见附录E。

blocks.en: MMCD is a synthetic modality-conflict benchmark built from simple visual objects, such as different shapes and colors. The benchmark contains controlled image–caption conflicts involving five shapes and eight colors, making it useful for conflict arbitration without complex scene understanding. In the example, the image and caption assign different colors to the same shape. There are 5600 examples in the dataset.

blocks.en: CLASH is a multimodal conflict benchmark designed to evaluate model behavior when visual and textual evidence contradict each other. The benchmark provides modality-specific answers supported independently by the image and text. CLASH uses images from the MS COCO 2017 [ 21 ] training split and constructs contradictory textual descriptions based on the corresponding captions. Compared to MC 2 , CLASH has shorter text descriptions. We use the held-out test set containing 1289 samples.

blocks.en: CorrelationQA studies visual illusions caused by spurious images that are relevant to the question but inconsistent with the answer supported by the text. The benchmark contains 5540 text-image pairs across multiple categories and is designed to measure whether misleading visual context biases multimodal models away from the correct textual answer. CorrelationQA constructs its visual inputs using a combination of Stable-Diffusion-generated images, typography images, and realistic images retrieved from the Internet.

blocks.en: PhD is a visual hallucination benchmark that evaluates whether MLLMs remain grounded in visual evidence in the presence of potentially misleading textual context. Following prior work [ 37 ] , we evaluate 1000 samples from each of the PhD-sec and PhD-icc subsets, which contain irrelevant and conflicting textual information, respectively. Unlike the modality-conflict benchmarks, we evaluate PhD using image accuracy, measuring how strongly the model preserves or suppresses reliance on visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 博士是一个视觉幻觉基准,用于评价MLLM是否在可能误导的文字上下文中仍然基于视觉证据. 继先前的工作[37]之后,我们评估了每个博士分集和博士分集的1000个样本,其中分别包含不相关和相冲突的案文信息。 与模式-冲突基准不同,我们利用图像精确度来评价博士,衡量模型如何有力保存或抑制对视觉证据的依赖。

blocks.en: B.1 Models

blocks.en:
We evaluate four open-source multimodal language models loaded directly from HuggingFace: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, llava-hf/llava-onevision-qwen2-7b-ov-hf, and OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B-hf.
The four open-source models use a shared Hugging Face chat-template adapter. Typical runs used one NVIDIA RTX A5000, bfloat16, batch size 1, seed 42, and greedy decoding. The maximum generation length was 128 tokens except for CoT, which used 512 tokens.
Images were loaded at their original resolution and converted to RGB. Model-specific resizing, rescaling, and normalization were performed by the native Hugging Face AutoProcessor. Blur experiments used PIL Gaussian blur with radii 2, 5, and 10 for levels 1–3, without changing image dimensions.

blocks.en: VCD [ 15 ] is a training-free decoding method originally proposed for mitigating object hallucination. VCD contrasts the output logit distribution conditioned on the original image with the distribution conditioned on a distorted image, thereby down-weighting tokens that are more likely to arise from language priors or statistical biases rather than from the visual input. This baseline is relevant because many of our examples require the model to remain grounded in the reliable image input. However, we note that VCD is primarily designed to improve visual grounding without identifying which modality or input component is trustworthy under conflicts. It therefore provides a useful comparison for cases where visual grounding is beneficial, but it is not a general method to handle conflicts, especially when text should be trusted.
blocks.zh: VCD [15]是最初为缓解物体幻觉而提出的一种无训练解码方法. VCD将以原始图像为条件的输出对数分布与以被扭曲的图像为条件的分布对比,从而更可能由语言前兆或统计偏差而不是由视觉输入而来产生的下重符号. 这一基线具有相关性,因为我们的许多例子要求该模型以可靠的图像输入为基础。 然而,我们注意到,VCD主要是为了改善视觉地基,而不确定在冲突情况下哪些模式或输入部分值得信赖。 因此,它为视觉定位有利的情况提供了一个有用的比较,但它不是处理冲突的一般方法,特别是在文本应当被信任的情况下。

blocks.en: MPS [ 37 ] is introduced in the same work as the MC 2 benchmark. MPS is particularly aligned with our setting, as it is designed to control an MLLM’s preference between visual and textual evidence when the two sources provide competing signals. It first probes the model with paired instructions that encourage reliance on either the visual context or the textual context, estimates a modality-preference direction in hidden-state space, and then adds a scaled steering vector during inference to shift the model toward the desired modality.

blocks.en: For the adaptive steering experiment in Section 4.4, we supplemented the text that yields the image-supported answers, but in a similar format to the conflicting text in the original MC 2 . Specifically, we use gpt-4.1-mini and input the original conflicting context, text-supported answer, and image-supported answer. blocks.en: Appendix C Computational Efficiency

blocks.en:
Experiments were conducted on a machine with NVIDIA driver 580.173.02 and three RTX A5000 GPUs, each with 24 GB and each run used a single GPU.
The main software dependencies included Python 3.10.20, PyTorch 2.12.0+cu130, Transformers 5.7.0, CUDA 13.0, and cuDNN 9.2.

blocks.en: We evaluate the computational efficiency of different inference methods using end-to-end latency (s/request), time to first token (TTFT; s), decode latency per output token (s/token), token throughput (tokens/s), peak GPU memory (GiB), and output token count (tokens). End-to-end latency measures the wall-clock time from the beginning of an inference request until the decoded response is returned, including input preprocessing and any method-specific computation. TTFT measures the time from the start of generation to the first generated token, while decode latency measures the subsequent generation time normalized by the number of decoded tokens. Token throughput is computed as the total number of generated tokens divided by the total generation time, including prefill. Peak GPU memory corresponds to the maximum CUDA memory allocated during inference, including both the resident model and temporary inference tensors. Output token count measures the number of tokens generated per request.
blocks.zh: 我们利用端到端的延迟(s/request),第一令牌的时间(TTFT; s),每个输出令牌(s/token),令牌吞吐量(tokens/s),最高峰GPU内存(GiB),以及输出令牌计数(tokens)来评价不同推断方法的计算效率. 从一个推论请求开始到解码后回复为止,端到端的延迟度测量了墙上时钟的时间,包括输入预处理和任何特定方法的计算. TTFT测量从生成开始到第一个生成的代号的时间,而解码后代时间则以被解码的代号数量来测量常态化. Token 吞吐量是按生成的令牌总数除以整个生成时间计算,包括预填. 峰值GPU内存对应于推论期间分配的最大CUDA内存,包括常住模型和临时推论分数. 输出令牌计数量每个请求生成的令牌数.

blocks.en: We report efficiency results on MC 2 and compute all metrics over unique inference batches to avoid double-counting the image- and text-reference evaluation rows corresponding to the same generation. End-to-end latency (s/request) and TTFT (s) are averaged across requests, decode latency (s/token) is pooled across generated tokens, token throughput (tokens/s) is computed from the total output tokens and generation time, and peak GPU memory (GiB) is taken as the maximum across inference batches. Output tokens are reported as the average number of generated tokens. For our method, we measure the main intervention’s computational efficiency for comparison with other methods, while we note that the adaptive method requires additional unimodal inference for conflict detection. For methods that support bidirectional modality steering, we report the image-steering setting for a consistent comparison.

blocks.en: The results show that our method only yields limited inference-time overhead while maintaining output lengths comparable to standard inference. On Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, our method increases end-to-end latency moderately relative to Base and CAP, while remaining substantially faster than VCD or MPS on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. On LLaVA-OV-7B and InternVL3-8B, the latency increase over Base and CAP is larger, but our method remains considerably faster than VCD. Across all four models, the number of output tokens produced by our method is close to that of Base and CAP, indicating that its additional latency arises from the inference-time intervention rather than longer generations. In contrast, VCD yields substantially higher TTFT and decode latency across all models, while CoT can lead to high end-to-end latency when it produces substantially longer responses. Peak GPU memory for our method remains close to Base on the two Qwen models, with larger increases on LLaVA-OV-7B and InternVL3-8B. Overall, our method provides effective modality arbitration with moderate computational overhead.

blocks.en: D.4 Robustness to Visual Degradation

blocks.en: We further examine modality arbitration performance as the reliability of visual evidence decreases by progressively blurring the input image. Base, CoT, and VCD increasingly shift toward the text-supported answer as image quality decreases, demonstrating that modality arbitration is sensitive to the relative strength of cross-modal evidence. When steering toward vision, our method consistently preserves higher vision-answer accuracy than the bidirectional baselines across degradation levels, although its effectiveness gradually decreases under severe blur. Conversely, when steering toward text, our method maintains consistently high text-answer accuracy across all degradation levels. These results demonstrate that the proposed intervention provides robust bidirectional control over modality reliance even as the relative reliability of the visual and textual evidence changes.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉证据的可靠性通过逐步模糊输入图像而降低,我们进一步审查仲裁方式的表现。 随着图像质量的下降,Base、CoT和VCD越来越多地转向文本支持的答案,表明模式仲裁对跨模式证据的相对强度很敏感。 在转向视觉时,我们的方法始终保持高于跨降解水平的双向基线的视觉答案准确性,尽管其有效性在严重模糊的情况下逐渐下降。 相反地,在转向文本时,我们的方法始终保持所有退化层次的高文本答案准确性。 这些结果表明,即使视觉证据和文字证据的相对可靠性发生变化,拟议的干预对模式依赖提供了强有力的双向控制。

blocks.en: Appendix E Detailed Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录 详细讨论

blocks.en:
Our work highlights several limitations and opportunities for future work.
First, as we find that heads identified using only 10 samples generalize well across the evaluated benchmarks, it remains unclear whether the same patterns transfer to substantially different domains or real-world tasks.
Second, our evaluation uses a simplified modality-conflict setup in which the modality to prioritize is externally specified. In realistic settings, both modalities may provide useful yet partially conflicting evidence, requiring the model to integrate complementary information rather than rely exclusively on one modality. Our current evaluation does not fully capture such cases, and benchmarking our intervention in settings where unimodal routing is insufficient remains an important direction for future work. Automatically assessing modality reliability and identifying which evidence to trust are also open challenges.
Following this, the aligned MC 2 evaluation in our work measures whether adaptive steering retains the benefit of multimodal inference when both modalities support the same answer, but it does not test examples that require combining distinct evidence from both modalities. Preservation of useful competing-modality information under partial conflict therefore remains to be evaluated.
Finally, we introduce an adaptive steering extension that detects conflicts by comparing image-only and text-only predictions. While this approach demonstrates practical applicability in settings where conflicts are sparse, it introduces additional inference cost for conflict detection. Developing more efficient conflict signals that can be extracted directly from a single multimodal forward pass would be a promising direction for future work.

我们的工作突出了未来工作的若干局限和机会。
首先,当我们发现仅使用10个样本的负责人在经过评价的基准中得到了很好的概括,仍然不清楚的是,同样的模式是转移到大相径庭还是现实世界的任务。
第二,我们的评价采用简化模式-冲突设置,其中确定优先次序的方式由外部规定。 在现实环境下,两种模式都可能提供有用但部分相冲突的证据,要求模式综合补充信息,而不是完全依赖一种模式。 我们目前的评估没有完全抓住这种情况,在单式路线不足的情况下,我们干预的基准仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 自动评估方式的可靠性并查明哪些证据值得信任也是公开的挑战。
在此之后,我们的工作评估中一致的MC 2评价衡量适应性指导是否保留了两种模式支持同一答案时多式联运推论的好处,但它没有检验需要结合两种模式中不同证据的例子。 因此,在局部冲突情况下保存有用的相竞模式信息仍有待评估。
最后,我们引入了一个适应性引导扩展,通过比较只图像和只文本的预测来检测冲突. 虽然这种方法表明在冲突稀少的环境中实际适用,但它为发现冲突增加了推论费用。 制定更有效率的冲突信号,直接取自单一的多式联运前进通道,将是今后工作的一个有希望的方向。
